The '''Blenjeel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dufilvian sector/Legends|Dufilvian sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Blenjeel]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[sand burrower]]s.<ref name="Jedi Academy" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blenjeel system was originally created for ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Wikipedia:First-person shooter|first-]] and [[Wikipedia:Third-person shooter|third-person shooter]] developed by [[Raven Software]]<ref name="Jedi Academy" /> and released on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="Jedi Academy release date">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2003/09/16/star-wars-jedi-knight-jedi-academy-review|text=Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy Review|author=Butts, Steve|date=2003-09-16|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|''IGN'']]|archivedate=20200401045956}}</ref> It was first identified in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed the system in grid square Q-15.<ref name="TEA" />
